settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Leave empty to set the name in the heading face: the designed look, not a fallback.

settings.label: Name
settings.info: On the header, the footer and every page title. Leave empty to use the workspace name.

settings.label: Reveal on scroll
settings.info: Rows, slips, cards and the photo wall's prints fade in once as the page scrolls. Never the first screen.

settings.label: Headings rise in
settings.info: Page titles and section headings rise in word by word.

settings.label: Opening hours
settings.info: One line per day or range, the time last: Monday to Friday 9:00–16:00, Sunday Closed.

settings.label: Access
settings.info: Step-free entrance, hearing loop, toilets, parking.

settings.label: Map image
settings.info: A map or a photo of the door, 4:3.

settings.label: Map embed link
settings.info: A map's embed address. Set, it replaces the map image on Visit.

settings.label: Header button link
settings.info: Leave the label or the link empty to hide the button.

settings.label: Support link
settings.info: Adds Support the house to the footer. Empty hides it.
